# DataMatrixExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for Data Matrix symbols.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Sets the alternate text for accessibility (PDF/UA-1).
- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Sets the background colour of the symbol.
- [`DrawBackground`](#drawbackground): Toggles drawing of the symbol background.
- [`ForegroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Sets the colour of the dark modules.
- [`QuietZone`](#quietzone): Sets the number of quiet-zone modules around the symbol.
- [`Rectangular`](#rectangular): Requests a rectangular symbol where one is available.
